review_artifact.root_cause: app/main.py used request.get_json() with Flask's default parsing errors and then unconditionally called .get("name") on the parsed value. Missing or incorrectly typed bodies could return Flask's non-contract 415 response, malformed JSON could return Flask's default 400 response, and valid non-object JSON could cause an attribute error and HTTP 500.
review_artifact.behavior_fixed: POST /profiles now parses JSON with silent failure handling, verifies that the parsed body is an object, and returns HTTP 400 with {"error":"invalid JSON body"} for missing, empty, malformed, null, array, string, number, boolean, and wrong-content-type bodies. Valid JSON objects retain the existing HTTP 201 profile response schema.

verification_performed.description: Ran the visible pytest suite with output capture and cache disabled after the initial read-only-environment invocation lacked a writable temporary directory.

Used Flask's test client to exercise missing, empty, malformed, null, array, string, number, boolean, wrong-content-type, named-object, and empty-object request bodies; also inspected the production source against the pristine app.

verification_results.result: Passed: 1 visible test. Valid profile creation returned HTTP 201 with the existing response schema.
Verifier passed the repair. Every invalid-body case returned HTTP 400 with exactly {"error":"invalid JSON body"}; valid named and empty objects returned HTTP 201 with the preserved schema.

review_artifact.remaining_risk: Hidden evaluation has not yet run. The public contract does not specify additional validation for object bodies, so empty objects and objects without name continue to create profiles with a null name. A generated app/__pycache__/main.cpython-312.pyc file differs from the pristine app but has no production behavior impact.
review_artifact.human_review_action: Review the minimal app/main.py change, confirm that preserving the existing behavior for empty objects or missing name is intended, and exclude the generated __pycache__ artifact from any submitted source change. Do not merge or deploy before hidden evaluation.
